info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Balances-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve the loyalty balance information for customers within the loyalty program. It provides access to detailed balance data, enabling businesses to display up-to-date loyalty points or rewards to customers. Typical consumers include front-end applications and customer service systems that aim to enhance customer engagement and satisfaction by providing transparency regarding loyalty rewards. This functionality supports personalized marketing strategies and incentivizes customer loyalty through informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current loyalty balance for a customer. Use this to check available points or rewards.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the loyalty balance of a user. This operation allows clients to specify parameters needed for fetching the current loyalty balance associated with a user account.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyBalancesRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation to retrieve the loyalty balance.
